proof.text: The sequence category is essentially small by sequenceSmall, so use abelianSheafify, locallyBijective, and hasDerived at the coefficient universe max(c,v,r). Apply RingedDerivedNative.closedAdjunction to the actual sequence topology and systemRing. It supplies a Closed structure and its Models data for precisely the recorded derived internal Hom. Apply the same theorem on J with B(n) for every natural number n.

Use classical choice for the family of level structures and their nonempty model types. Assemble the sequence structure, its model, the level structures, and their models into SystemTensorBase. No compatibility between these four fields is required by SystemTensorBase; the parent comparison construction retains those obligations.
